messages:
deploy-bot: Starting staged router shift to backend-v3 at 22:00 UTC. Plan: 15% -> backend-v3 for 10m, then evaluate. Command: /deploy router shift --to backend-v3 --percent 15 --window 10m
Maya Patel: hold on — did we pin v3 to the quantized artifact? last time token quality regressed.
Sam Liu: yes pinned to v3-quant-2026-03-19 (sha: abc123). infra confirmed build+quant flags. link: https://artifacts.internal/redwood/v3-quant-2026-03-19
Kevin Ortiz: oncall here. watching p99 and 502s. Trigger threshold: p99 > 1.5x baseline or errors > 1.5x -> manual hold.
deploy-bot: shift started at 22:00 UTC. current split: backend-v3=15%, backend-v2=85%. metrics(3m): p50 +1%, p95 +2%, errors x1.1
Li Chen: I'm seeing session affinity loss for cookie-based routing — some clients lose context when hit v3. Repro steps: log in -> start convo -> second request lands on other backend -> context missing
Maya Patel: ouch. can we flip affinity header? maybe router missing sticky header on v3.
Sam Liu: quick mitigation: set backend-v3=5% to reduce exposure and fix header mapping. If we can't patch in 10m, full rollback.
Kevin Ortiz: agree. also notify SRE to look at router sticky-session logs. @oncall-bot enable debug-mode on router for cohort A.
oncall-bot: Debug mode enabled for router-cohort-A. Capturing sticky-session logs for 10m. :mag_right:
deploy-bot: Executed weight change at 22:07 UTC: backend-v3=5%, backend-v2=95%.
Kevin Ortiz: alert from monitors: /generate errors spiked to 1.6x baseline after initial shift. manual rollback recommended.
Maya Patel: I vote rollback. We can pin v3 to staging and re-run with header fix in next window.
Sam Liu: rolling back now: router set-weight backend-v3=0 backend-v2=100
deploy-bot: Rollback executed at 22:12 UTC. Confirmed split: backend-v3=0%, backend-v2=100%. Revert note added to release log. :white_check_mark:
Kevin Ortiz: monitoring post-rollback. p99 back to baseline. Will file follow-up ticket to fix affinity header mapping and add canary for sticky sessions.
Maya Patel: thanks everyone. add a note in release notes: "temporary rollback due to session-affinity mismatch; retry after header fix". Assign to Sam for next deploy.
Sam Liu: noted. scheduling a patch and new canary with header test in next maint window. :thumbsup:
